description: Search the Phở Skills library: over 500 free, openly licensed (MIT / Apache-2.0) agent skills (SKILL.md format) for research, clinical work, legal, finance, marketing, SEO, sales, data and engineering, from publishers such as Anthropic, Cloudflare, Hugging Face, Stripe and Supabase. Describe the task (e.g. "review an NDA", "write a cold email sequence", "run a survival analysis in R"); results are ranked by how many of its words match the skill name, set and description. Each result has the skill id, what it is for, its publisher and licence, and links. Call get_skill with an id to read the full instructions and its supporting files. Results come from the published index only; say plainly when nothing matched rather than suggesting skills from memory.

category.description: Optional category id, e.g. research, clinical, legal, finance, marketing, sales, data, engineering, design.

publisher.description: Optional publisher name, e.g. Anthropic, Cloudflare.

query.description: The task, in plain words (English works best).
